subject: Anchored renewal + staggered uplift proposal for Acme Data Labs
messages:
From: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@acmedata.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal window + restructure options for next fiscal

Hi Priya,

Hope you’re well. Our current agreement with Redwood rolls into renewal next quarter and we need to rework the term so it lines up with our fiscal planning. A few context points: the analytics BU is planning to consolidate contracts to a single calendar cycle (targeting 2028-01-01), and usage has grown ~45% YTD.

Procurement asked whether we can explore: a multi-year term with a staged ramp, co-terming with the analytics BU, and an explicit opt-out window on auto-renew. They also flagged budget smoothing — would like levelized cash impact in year 1 if possible.

Can we set up a 30-minute call next week to run through concrete options? Please share any initial structures you typically recommend for similar customers.

Thanks,
Susan
Susan Lewis
Head of Platform Ops — Acme Data Labs

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@acmedata.com>
Date: 2027-09-11T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + restructure options for next fiscal

Hi Susan — thanks for the clarity. That all makes sense.

High level we can offer three practical structures to hit the goals you outlined:
- 3-year anchored term with a staged uplift (low Year 1 commitment + predictable step-ups Year 2/3) to smooth spend.
- 2-year co-term option where the second year aligns both BUs into a single renewal date and includes a carve-out for burst capacity.
- 1-year renewal with an explicit auto-renew opt-out and quarterly true-up to avoid overprovisioning.

I'd like to bring a short internal proposal to the call with numbers and a recommendation. Does 2027-09-14 at 10:00am PT work for a quick sync? I’ll include our pricing lead and account manager.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-12T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Acme: need two proposal structures (anchored + co-term) — numbers inside

Team — quick summary from the discovery call with Acme (Susan + procurement):
- Goal: align Analytics BU to calendar renew 2028-01-01, smooth FY28 spend, support 45% usage growth YTD.
- Constraints: procurement requires an opt-out window on auto-renew; legal wants clear SLA credits for capacity shortfalls; finance prefers spread cost in Y1.

Please prepare two candidate structures we can send to Acme by Oct 15:
A) Anchored 3-year (recommended):
  - Year 1 commit: 0.85x current baseline (to lower cash hit), Year 2: 1.2x, Year 3: 1.45x
  - Annualized pricing with levelized invoice option (invoice smoothing)
  - Built-in burst bucket: 10% monthly, billed on usage beyond commit
  - Auto-renew: enable with explicit 60-day opt-out before renewal; early-exit penalty only if usage exceeds 200% of aggregate commit
B) Co-term transitional (trade-off):
  - 2-year term, second year aligns both BUs to 2028-01-01 co-term; up-front partial prepay option to smooth P&L
  - Year 1 blended commit tied to combined forecast; flexible true-ups every quarter

Attachments: I pulled their sample usage file (current-usage-2027Q2.csv). Please propose model-level pricing deltas for quantization/throughput optimizations and any onboarding credits we can offer to reduce start-of-term friction.

I need a short pricing sheet and an internal recommendation by 2027-09-20.

Thanks — Priya
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-09-18T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme: need two proposal structures (anchored + co-term) — numbers inside

Priya — draft numbers below (quick notes inline). Quoted previous for context.

> Year 1 commit: 0.85x current baseline (to lower cash hit), Year 2: 1.2x, Year 3: 1.45x

Suggested pricing buckets (headroom included):
- Baseline current monthly avg tokens: 18M tokens
- Proposed Year 1 monthly commit (avg): 15.3M tokens (0.85x) — price per 1k tokens: $1.90 (10% discount vs list)
- Year 2 monthly commit: 21.6M tokens — price per 1k tokens: $1.80 (volume step-down)
- Year 3 monthly commit: 26.1M tokens — price per 1k tokens: $1.65
- Burst: $0.0025 per token above monthly bucket (up to 10%)

Commercial concessions to enable co-terming:
- Offer 3 months onboarding credit applied as one-time invoice credit (value $35k) if they sign 3yr anchored.
- If they choose co-term 2yr path, offer a blended prepay option (6 months) with 5% discount.

Notes for Marissa: I flagged SLA credit language with legal — recommend a capped/service-level credit schedule rather than automatic termination.

-Marissa/Rishi — please add operational risks or supply-side constraints if anticipated.

Karthik
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@acmedata.com>, Acme Procurement <procure@acmedata.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-10-15T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Anchored 3yr term + staggered uplift (proposal attached)

Susan / procurement team — thanks for your patience while we assembled options. Attached is a concise proposal (Acme-proposal-2027-10-15.pdf) with two paths so leadership can choose the best fit:

Path 1 (Recommended) — 3-year Anchored Term- Year 1 monthly baseline commit = 15.3M tokens (0.85x current); Levelized invoicing available to smooth FY28 cash flow.- Year 2 monthly commit = 21.6M tokens; Year 3 monthly commit = 26.1M tokens.- Burst bucket = 10% (billed on actuals).- Onboarding credit = $35,000 applied in first invoice if signed within 30 days.- Auto-renew enabled; 60-day opt-out window before renewal. SLA credit schedule included (capped).

Path 2 — 2-year Co-term Transition- Year 1 blended commit to align with both BUs; Quarterly true-ups; optional 6-month prepay with 5% discount; co-term alignment target = 2028-01-01.

Next steps:
1) Review attached and flag which path leadership prefers.
2) If leadership prefers Path 1, we’ll send a redline-ready amendment and the onboarding credit voucher.
3) If Path 2, we’ll prepare a short amendment to include the prepay mechanics and quarterly true-up doc.

Can you confirm decision by 2027-11-01 to preserve the onboarding credit? Happy to hop on a call to walk through the numbers.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
